name: Writ of Protected Passage (Thaumaturgy, Level Two Ritual)

system.description:
Developed by the Tremere expatriate Wan Zhu as a countermeasure to Ward Versus Cathayans, this ritual uses a small amount of the subject's blood to draw protective sigils on paper, creating a charm that shields its bearer from the ward's effects. Creating the charm takes about 10 minutes; it works only for the Kuei-jin whose blood was used, lasts 24 hours, and is instantly destroyed by exposure to sunlight.

System: A Kuei-jin carrying a Writ of Protected Passage is automatically immune to a Ward Versus Cathayans ritual so long as she carries the writ. If she loses or destroys it, or it is exposed to sunlight, it stops working. Only one writ bearing a given individual's blood can be in effect at a time; any additional writs made from the same blood have no power.
system.source: San Francisco by Night, Chapter Six: Storytelling San Francisco
system.bloodCost: A small sample of the protected subject's blood
